g.text: Note this IO is UART TX-capable

~USER_BUTTON~ pulled low with weak pad pull, can be driven by button and sampled by user code without disturbing flash chip select.
Passive values aren't quite right, they are just ~~close values already in the design.

DVI sink is terminated to +3V3, approx 50 ohm series. GPIO output high -> approx 0 current GPIO output low -> approx -10mA, single-ended This is reasonably close to actual CML logic levels. Open-drain output would be better, but the pads seem not to respond to OEN toggling at 252 Mbps!
